title: Supreme Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
summary: Gain one extra level 4 spell slot until Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Grants an additional level 4 spell slot and replaces other elixirs. Sorcerers can convert it into a permanent-until-rest created slot with their class action even before normally unlocking level 4 slots.
fields.Recipe: Essence of Beholder Eye plus any Suspension. Potion and elixir merchants can stock it from level 9.
fields.Base value: 160 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
